Returns `Ok(PhpType::Void)` on success. fn check(cx: &mut BuiltinCheckCtx) -> Result<PhpType, CompileError> { let ty = cx.checker.infer_type(&cx.args[0], cx.env)?; // An `array|false` union (scandir, glob, file) reads through to its array member; // the sort lowering pairs the acceptance with an unbox-or-throw for the `false`. let ty = ty.array_or_false_member().cloned().unwrap_or(ty); if !matches!(ty, PhpType::Array(_) | PhpType::AssocArray { .. }) { return Err(CompileError::new(cx.span, &format!("{}() argument must be array", cx.name))); } Ok(PhpType::Void) }
